scope: Independent read-only mapper-design review against pinned local source/receipts. This reviewer did not author this mapper design. The separately reviewed owner design was not re-reviewed or treated as implementation authority.
conclusion: No concrete contradiction found in the checked mapper direction. The design keeps genuine map/unmap and invalid-lookup success blocked, retains exposed backing/IOVA independently of swallowed framework errors, and preserves the finite frozen lifecycle.

checks.point: Real map/unmap remain unsuccessful pending reviewed same-owner bridge
checks.assessment: The design explicitly refuses present start/publication and real map/unmap success. Native79 and control002 are not represented as exposure authority; no fake codec/model result can satisfy these callbacks.

evidence.source_fact: Exact six pure virtual callbacks match the design, including IOReturn map/unmap and scalar translation.
Public API exposes private pin/configure/acquire/zero/copy/retire/inspect only; no effect or owned-view export.
private_core requires no effects, pending ticket or ever_resources.
Current private operations retain/refuse when that private-core condition no longer holds.

checks.point: Invalid translation cannot return zero or identity as a failure value
checks.assessment: The uint64_t return has no error channel. The design rejects success-shaped failure values and makes containment/fail-stop an explicit blocker before subclass admission. Merely remaining non-system would not protect direct IODMACommand callers; the existing design blocker must cover them too.

evidence.source_fact: mapToPhysicalAddress returns uint64_t, without a separate status.
IOMappedRead/Write use the returned address directly in physical-access functions without a failure check.
A non-global command mapper translation also goes directly to copypv; no zero/identity failure check.

checks.point: First mapping is one whole16KiB data page, never the32-byte ring prefix
checks.assessment: Root, leaf and data are each16KiB, and data descriptor length/returned map extent are exactly0x4000. The ring prefix is explicitly a use within that extent. No32B mapping admission is suggested.

evidence.source_fact: Frozen codec has16KiB granule and bounded graph/table limits.
Core has3 spans and16KiB page size.
Every bound span must have BPL_PAGE bytes; data also requires aligned bounded IOVA and rights.
Nonzero returned allocation length unequal to requested length selects multisegment processing.
That multisegment path invokes iovmInsert, outside the proposed first profile.

checks.point: Bounded aperture/zero/MSI exclusion and no reservation reuse after an effect
checks.assessment: 0x00100000+0xbfe00000 equals0xbff00000; the stated half-open aperture matches frozen constants. It excludes zero and lies below the separately reserved MSI page. The design adds a future monotonic reservation/tombstone contract; it does not claim an allocator already exists. Cancellation is allowed only before exposure under known-private ownership.

evidence.source_fact: Separate32-bit IOVA/36-bit PA limits, aperture base/size and MSI page match the design.
Software validation requires page containment in aperture and separately rejects MSI overlap.
Core IOVA bounds use the same lower and upper values.
Any effect/pending/ever_resources blocks private retirement, so successful/no-op histories cannot make an exposed reservation reclaimable.

checks.point: Swallowed unmap errors cannot release independently held owner references
checks.assessment: Source confirms the exact hazard. The design therefore requires actual boot-lifetime strong references, an independent explicit prepare pair and immutable table/IOVA/control records before publication. Timeout alone is not treated as retention. A future bridge must prove these references survive caller state clearing and service teardown; no such implementation is admitted here.

evidence.source_fact: kIOMDDMAUnmap assigns dmaUnmap result but returns kIOReturnSuccess.
DMA reference accounting decrements before iovmUnmapMemory and allocation accounting updates afterward despite its return.
complete clears local allocation validity/address/length and prepared state after the unmap call.
clearMemoryDescriptor loops complete then resets the descriptor reference.
Descriptor free ignores dmaUnmap status and then drops its memory-entry state.
Buffer free invokes super::free and then deallocates backing. A separate retained owner must prevent reaching this path while exposure remains possible.

checks.point: 32-effect lifetime bound applies; continuous map/unmap is another design
checks.assessment: The design requires a complete finite worst-case budget strictly below32, not the host example count. It explicitly prohibits rolling history, reinitialization, another registry or exposed IOVA reuse. Quarantined core entries cannot start another ticket; future containment must obey that frozen rule rather than reopening the journal.

evidence.source_fact: BPL_EFFECTS is32.
Quarantine or a pending ticket refuses begin; history is appended and the32-entry limit is checked before commit.
Failed/unknown/stale results retain/quarantine rather than resetting history.
Private retirement remains forbidden after any effect.

checks.assessment: The proposal describes future obligations only. Current start/publication and real-engine success remain blocked. A granule constant does not justify a service. No write order, new physical address, MSI layout or hardware action is supplied.

evidence.source_fact: Base start calls initHardware before page-size/system-mapper/property setup; fIsSystem would alter gSystem, so avoiding that path remains important.
Device association uses iommu-parent/property matching and may wait indefinitely; numeric IOMapperID is not SID ownership.
Codec validation/translation explicitly perform no allocation, MMIO, publication, DMA or hardware barrier.
Pinned STOP preserves PHY_NOT_READY, no initialization/retry/P_PCIE_INIT, compiled-out shared writers, no next boot and GPU observer hold.

checks.point: Frozen leaves and1024-byte frame guard remain unchanged
checks.assessment: All43 own files named by the five cited leaf freezes match their receipts. Design direction is not source/subclass/build admission. The existing1024-byte individual frame guard remains mandatory; no new frame measurement or compilation was performed.

evidence.source_fact: Guard remains1024; original over-limit failure is retained, not regraded.
